Open-H-RF


An open, large-scale, community-driven dataset of medical ultrasound raw channel data



  
  
  
  



	
		
	
	
		Dataset Description
	

Open-H-RF is a community-driven dataset initiative building the open, shared foundation needed to train and evaluate AI models built on pre-beamformed (channel capture) medical ultrasound measurements.
This dataset is a collection of RF samples and metadata in the zea file format from a variety of tasks and applications, including ultrasound… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Open-H-RF.
